title: complete queues a head whose verification waits for a slot instead of timing out
description: Runs the real CLI complete, control plane and host verification pump while every verification slot is held past the request's time. complete returns 'queued for verification; the loop submits it' and records no blocker; once a slot frees, the loop runs the verification and submits the head, which reaches review with no blocker in its history and no second complete.

steps.name: complete queues for a slot, then the loop verifies and submits
